notes.title: New windowed mode
notes.notes:
Hello, the Windowed Mode is available now.

Three modes: fullscreen, windowed, slim (mobile like).
It should remember mode, which screen and position.

You can set your preferred mode on the main menu, in the settings, there’s a ‘resize’ button.

Let us know any issue or improvements you want to see.
